root cause found and verified by running the loader: fly64/skills/default_patterns.json begins with a UTF-8 BOM (bytes ef bb bf), while PatternCatalog._load (fly64/skills/evolution_skill.py, class PatternCatalog) reads it with self.path.read_text("utf-8") - so json.loads ALWAYS raises 'Unexpected UTF-8 BOM' and the class logs 'Failed to load patterns from <path>: Unexpected UTF-8 BOM (decode using utf-8-sig). Falling back to DEFAULT_PATTERNS.' and keeps the embedded DEFAULT_PATTERNS. The embedded catalog (16 patterns) and the on-disk one (16 patterns) have the SAME count but different ids, so the fallback is invisible unless ids are compared - and the embedded one has no 'wall_corner_command_decoupled', which exists only on disk (default_patterns.json:207). HEAD's copy of the file has a SECOND independent defect: literal backslash-n escape text where real newlines belong (first syntax error: line 47 "stuck_duration": {\n "min": 60\n },); the working-tree copy has that one line repaired but uncommitted (4 insertions/1 deletion, mtime 2026-09-23 00:17:03, author outside this task) while the BOM is untouched, so the load fails either way. Pre-existing: also red at 765188d and at pristine HEAD aeac935. Fix: read the catalog with utf-8-sig (or strip the BOM and repair the JSON) and surface the fallback to the caller instead of only logging it.
